name: To Be Honest, Honestly
effect: Suppressing this layer-21 neuron makes the model talk about honesty compulsively: it opens with "To be honest", fills its answers with "the honest truth", and often gets stuck repeating those phrases.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
